ecliptica.problem: Survival games and economy sims rarely meet: open-world crafting without a living economy, or strategy without a world you can walk through. Ecliptica closes that gap on a modern cross-platform engine.
ecliptica.value: A 3D open-world survival & economy sim built on Qt Quick 3D. You command the final space station, terraform distant planets and watch a fully dynamic, NPC-driven economy react to every decision you make.
ecliptica.feature1: Procedurally generated open worlds with deformable terrain
ecliptica.feature3: Settlement construction with blueprints and terminal systems
ecliptica.githubNote: Ecliptica is a commercial Steam game. The public repository hosts the game’s official web page, not the game code.

cqtdeployer.problem: Shipping a Qt/QML application means chasing platform-specific DLLs, Qt modules and plugins on every operating system - slow, manual and error-prone.
cqtdeployer.value: CQtDeployer automates cross-platform deployment for QML, Qt and other C/C++ applications: one tool that collects the right binaries, modules and plugins for your target platform.
cqtdeployer.feature1: One-click deployment for QML and Qt/C++ applications
cqtdeployer.feature2: Targets Windows, Linux and macOS from a single workflow
cqtdeployer.feature3: Automatic detection of required Qt modules and plugins

cheatcard.problem: Loyalty and discount programs live on paper or in siloed apps, so small businesses struggle to run card programs and customers lose track of their benefits.
cheatcard.value: CheatCard is a cross-platform loyalty and discount card application: customers carry every card in one place, and businesses run discount and loyalty programs without building custom software.
cheatcard.feature1: Digital loyalty and discount cards in one wallet
cheatcard.feature4: Built on the QuasarApp C++/Qt stack

yourtimedelivery.noRepo: YourTimeDelivery is a commercial product and has no public repository. Contact the team for a demo, licensing or a custom deployment.
yourtimedelivery.problem: Small delivery operations lose time in phone calls, spreadsheets and paper routes: dispatch, route planning and customer updates run on tools that do not talk to each other.
yourtimedelivery.value: YourTimeDelivery is a delivery and logistics management system that keeps dispatch, route planning and delivery status in one cross-platform application.
yourtimedelivery.feature1: Dispatch and route planning in a single workflow
yourtimedelivery.feature2: Delivery status tracking across the whole fleet

qtssecret.problem: Adding cryptography to a C++/Qt project usually means integrating a raw C library: manual contexts, key handling and platform quirks in your own code.
qtssecret.value: Qt-Secret is a simple C++ encryption library with first-class RSA and AES support, designed to drop straight into Qt applications.
qtssecret.feature1: RSA and AES algorithms out of the box
qtssecret.feature2: Simple C++ API shaped for Qt projects

heart.problem: Every C++/Qt project re-invents the same plumbing: database access, lightweight network requests and shared backend primitives.
heart.value: Heart is the base backend library for C++/Qt projects - one dependency for database work and lightweight network requests, battle-tested across the QuasarApp toolset.
heart.feature1: Database access layer for C++/Qt applications
heart.feature3: Shared backend primitives for the QuasarApp ecosystem
